The test image shows a soybean stem node with **white, fluffy/cottony mycelial growth** concentrated at the node junction. The stem is otherwise green. This is the hallmark sign of White Mold (Sclerotinia stem rot).

Key evidence:
- White fluffy mycelium at the stem node — exactly matching "fluffy, white growth on soybean stems with gray to white lesions at nodes"
- The growth pattern at the node is diagnostic
- No leaf spots, no root rot, no vascular discoloration — ruling out most other candidates
